arguments.explanation: Generates and runs an interactive bash script to convert metrics like temperature, distance, and weight using bc.

input: bash calculator with decimal precision bc

arguments.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/bcalc.sh
#!/bin/bash
echo -e "══ TERMINAL CALCULATOR ══\r\nEnter math expression (e.g. 12*4.5 or sqrt(16)). Type 'q' to exit.\r"
while :; do
  read -p "calc> " expr
  [ "$expr" = "q" ] && break
  [ -z "$expr" ] && continue
  res=$(echo "scale=4; $expr" | bc -l 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$res" ]; then echo -e "Invalid expression\r"; else echo -e "= $res\r"; fi
done
EOF
tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Opening calculator" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "\r\n" && bash /tmp/bcalc.sh && rm -f /tmp/bcalc.sh && printf ""
arguments.explanation: Generates and runs an interactive bash script that calculates math expressions with decimal precision using bc.
arguments.goal: Launch interactive terminal calculator with decimal support
